Shenzhen XFT Medical Limited
does not manufacture consumer smartwatches, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), sleep trackers, or general remote patient monitoring systems
. Instead, they specialize in neurological rehabilitation, surface electromyography (sEMG) biofeedback, and functional electrical stimulation (FES) devices like foot drop systems.
Shenzhen XFT Medical Limited
Core Shenzhen XFT Medical Product Lines
Foot Drop Systems:
Wearable FES and NMES devices (such as the G4 and G3 systems) that help stimulate muscle movement for stroke or paralysis recovery.
Shenzhen XFT Medical Limited
Hand Rehabilitation:
Bluetooth-enabled EMG monitors and robotic rehabilitation gloves for hand and wrist drop recovery.
MedicalExpo
Pelvic Floor Muscle Trainers:
Home-use biofeedback probes and digital controllers for pelvic floor rehabilitation.
Shenzhen XFT Medical Limited
First Aid / CPR Training:
AED trainers and specialized CPR feedback wristbands (like the XFT-120H) designed to monitor CPR compression depth and rate during training.
